description: Corpus manifest for the bricker-os LLM terminal. The ask-bill edge function (vibeco Supabase) fetches this list and builds its system prompt from these files. Order = priority. content/ledger.json is the Sept 2026 signed-off ledger (from _source/facts.md). content/FACTS.md and content/stories/*.md are held out until they are refreshed to that ledger: they still carry retired facts and private details.
